notes.title: Bullet Witch Ver. 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have just released version 1.0.5. Thank you for your patience.
Please report any new issues you encounter with the game in the dedicated Bug Fixes and Requested Features thread.

Ver. 1.0.5 Updates:
-Fixes facial animation bug when casting Meteor
-Offline mode now working correctly
-Changes in key configuration no longer affect commands in menus
-Fixes issue where key configuration changes would require a controller to be connected

Please note that Ver. 1.0.4 was used only for internal testing purposes and will not be released.

notes.title: Bullet Witch Ver. 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have just released version 1.0.3.
Please report any new issues you encounter with the game in the dedicated Bug Fixes and Requested Features thread.

Ver. 1.0.3 Updates:
-The application window can no longer be moved when in borderless window mode
-Mouse actions/direction no longer impact the dash function

Issues we are looking into:
-Facial animation bug when casting Meteor
-Key config can't be changed if controller not plugged in
-Changes in key configuration also affect commands in menus
-Offline mode prevents game from launching

notes.title: Bullet Witch Ver. 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have just released version 1.0.2. Thank you for your patience as we resolved the following issues.

Ver. 1.0.2 Updates:
-Implemented ability to control camera while dodging
-Fixed bug restricting available resolutions for some users

Issues we are looking into:
-Facial animation bug when casting Meteor
-Users can move the application window when in borderless window mode
-Mouse actions/direction impacting the dash function
-Key config can't be changed if controller not plugged in
-Changes in key configuration also affect commands in menus

Note that Ver. 1.0.1 was used for only internal testing and will not be released.
